page.title: Phase Refinement
page.emptyPrompt: Enter a file stem and click Load to start refining.

hoverTips.showUncertainty: Overlay low-confidence (high-uncertainty) pixels on the map

tooltips.fileStem: Enter the dataset file stem (e.g. sample_B) of the multi-phase indexing checkpoint to load.
tooltips.searchDir: Optional folder to search for the checkpoint file; leave empty to use the default location.
tooltips.load: Load the indexing checkpoint for the given file stem and display its phase map.
tooltips.clear: Clear the loaded dataset and reset all overrides and pixel selection.
tooltips.uncertaintyOverlay: Toggle dimming of low-CI (uncertain) pixels on the phase map.
tooltips.phaseMapCanvas: Click a pixel to inspect its phase candidates and confidence index (CI).
tooltips.assign: Manually assign this phase to the selected pixel, overriding the automatic result.
tooltips.modePixel: Click mode: select individual pixels on the map to reassign their phase.
tooltips.ciThreshold: Set the confidence index (CI) threshold below which pixels count as uncertain.
tooltips.export: Export the refined phase map; opens the export URL from the summary.

inspector.title: Pixel Inspector
inspector.prompt: Click a pixel on the map to inspect its phase candidates.

phaseMap.ariaLabel: Phase map — click to inspect pixel
